results.title: (VIDEO) Apple May Delay Standard iPhone 18 to 2027 as Pro Models and Foldable Set for Fall Launch
results.description: Apple plans to release iPhone 18 Pro models in fall 2026, delaying standard versions until early 2027 due to supply constraints, marking a shift in its traditional launch strategy.
